Hana Miyazaki: Quick heads-up1: I'm polishing the release brief for v0.11.1 and doing a final sweep of SDK snippets + embed guide anchors. Pushed a tiny draft to staging. Can someone sanity-check links and a short Known Issues note?

Liam O'Connor: On it. Which Known Issue are you planning to call out?

Hana Miyazaki: The streaming duplicate-token case on Dedicated low-latency when retries occur. Short mitigation recommended: disable automatic retries client-side during streaming.

Priya Nair: Added a callout with that phrasing. Also found an anchor mismatch: the embed migration section lost the #migration-anchors heading after the recent restructure. I added the anchor in the embed guide and updated the crosslink.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 redirect detected (/old-embed-guide -> /guides/embed-migration). Broken anchor previously reported.

Liam O'Connor: Copy nit: the TL;DR bullet says "improved batching"  can we change to "improved batching and lower per-token cost" to make user impact explicit?

Hana Miyazaki: Good call. I'll update. Also switching the Python example to show responses.create instead of legacy generate.

Priya Nair: Verified highlighting on staging; code fences look fine. Also trimmed the migration step to one short command for clarity.

Liam O'Connor: Approving PR after link fixes. One suggestion: add a short note in Known Issues with a timeline-ish line: "fix targeted for runtime patch 0.11.2" so customers know when to expect it.

Hana Miyazaki: Added the ETA note. Planning to merge once CI finishes. Thanks! :rocket:

docs-bot: CI: docs build succeeded at 2425001038. Staging preview up.

Hana Miyazaki: Merged and deployed to prod: https://docs.redwood.com/whats-new/v0.11.1. Leaving this thread open 24h for post-publish smoke reports.

Priya Nair: Spot-checked prod links & snippets; good to close unless crawler reports extras.

Liam O'Connor: All clear from my side. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
